_about: Public-domain Frederic Dan Huntington (1819-1904), Unitarian preacher to Harvard University who became an Episcopalian and first Bishop of Central New York, for the Word Hoard: Lessons on the Parables of the Saviour (1848), Sermons for the People (1856), Christian Believing and Living (1860), Human Society (1860), Helps to a Holy Lent (1872), Steps to a Living Faith (1873), New Helps to a Holy Lent (1876), Christ in the Christian Year (1878) and The Fitness of Christianity to Man (1878). J. V. Huntington and William Huntington, on their own shelves, are other men. from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 61 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
